I’m ready to determine the SMILES string, but I need some information about the sample first. Could you provide any of the following for the compound?

- ¹H NMR spectrum (chemical shifts, multiplicities, integration)
- ¹³C NMR spectrum (chemical shifts)
- IR spectrum (key absorption bands)
- Mass spectrum (m/z values, molecular ion)
- A brief description of the compound (e.g., functional groups, molecular formula, physical appearance)

With that data I can deduce the structure and give you the correct SMILES notation.
